items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: I took, uh, music lessons underneath the direction of, uh, Mr. Waddell Corzell. He taught me the valve trombone.

ctx.x: That's fair. What about when you got started, if we can back up, on the valve trombone? Did anybody help you? Did you just pick it up on your own or what?

No, I took, uh, this is when I really started. I took, uh, music lessons underneath the direction of, uh, Mr. Waddell Corzell. He taught me the valve trombone. It was, uh, sort of simple. And, when I switched over to the slide trombone, he was still my, uh, music teacher every Saturday. It was, uh, like an hour, see. And, uh, every now and then, uh, uh, I go over there and, uh, I practice on the valve trombone. But, it's really not in any kind of shape to go on a job with or anything, you know. So, it needs a…
That's what it really do. Yeah. Did you have any other teachers? Did your father help you at all?
